@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+---
+assignees:

+- 01M39ZPCNPZCG3RPG9Q6WQKETZ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8a80
+title: 'R3: summarizer calls keep no prompt cache'
+---
+## Why
+
+Each compaction summarizer call runs on a new backend (`Session/RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:119-141`), so each call adds a new key to the fork's store and pushes out the cache of a real session. This task replaces the "no summarizer cache" part of ^3r4rsrz.
+
+## External dependency
+
+Fork task F6 ("a cache request that keeps nothing"). If the task-local key of R2 is accepted, F6 is its `.none` case.
+
+## What to do
+
+1. Make each summarizer call run with the "keep nothing" option: the flash tier and the own-model tier, on every compaction path (turn start, tool-result boundary, ceiling stop, overflow retry, caller `compact`).
+2. Do this with ^6wqketz, which puts each summarizer call on the queue of its own container.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A compaction adds no key to the store: the key count and the byte total are the same before and after (test).
+- [ ] The next pass of the compacted session still reuses its own cache (gated test). #generation-queue #prompt-cache
\ No newline at end of file
